title: Dogs That Know When Their Owners Are Coming Home and animal earthquake warnings

tellings.quote: animals that have these abilities better than humans and that was the subject of my book dogs that know when their owners are coming home

plain: Some animals have senses that are better than ours: dogs that seem to know when their owners are on the way home, and animals that seem to sense an earthquake before it hits. The scientist Rupert Sheldrake says this was the subject of his own book, Dogs That Know When Their Owners Are Coming Home. If he is right, animals would be picking up something that ordinary senses cannot explain.
